en.headline: Chief Executive holds first district consultation on five-year plan in Tuen Mun
en.dek: John Lee and principal officials met more than 130 residents at South Tuen Mun Government Secondary School on Sunday to gather views on Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address.
body: Chief Executive John Lee and principal officials held the first district consultation session on Sunday at South Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, meeting more than 130 residents and district representatives selected by the government.

Lee described the simultaneous consultation for the five-year plan and the annual policy address as especially meaningful. He said the policy address would serve as a progress report on the city’s first five-year plan, which aligns with China’s 15th five-year blueprint covering 2026 to 2030, and pledged to consider the views expressed.

Attendees came from diverse backgrounds including grass-roots and working-class residents, members of the business community, ethnic minority groups, professionals, students and retirees. The session focused on themes of boosting the economy and improving people’s livelihoods. The government has held more than 80 consultation sessions since June, with the public consultation period running until 14 August.

zh.headline: 李家超於屯門舉行首場五年規劃及施政報告地區諮詢會
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超與主要官員周日在南屯門官立中學會見逾130名市民及地區代表，就香港首個五年規劃及2026年施政報告聽取意見。
body: 行政長官李家超與主要官員周日在南屯門官立中學舉行首場地區諮詢會，與政府挑選的逾130名市民及地區代表會面。
李家超表示，同時諮詢五年規劃及年度施政報告尤其有意義。他指施政報告將作為首個五年規劃的進度報告，該規劃與國家第十五個五年規劃（2026至2030年）接軌，並承諾會考慮市民意見。
與會者來自不同背景，包括基層及在職市民、商界、少數族裔、專業人士、學生及退休人士。會議圍繞拼經濟謀發展及惠民生建未來兩個主題。政府自六月以來已舉行逾80場諮詢會，公眾諮詢期至8月14日。
